니센(NISSEN, 日泉ケーブル)은 일본 오사카부 기시와다에 있는 자전거: NISSEN (日泉ケーブル) is a bicycle cable maker in Kishiwada, Osaka, Japan. It opened in 1948 making springs for weaving looms, later began making bicycle brake wire, and took its current name, Nissen Cable, in 1973. For many years it has made OEM cables for bicycle makers, brake makers and wholesalers.
니센은 자전거용 브레이크 아우터와 이너 와이어를 일본에서 가공해 판매합니: Nissen processes and sells bicycle brake outer casing and inner wire in Japan: stainless cables, vintage cables reissued from 1950s to 1970s Europe, and cables in special lengths for bikes such as tandems. A brand that has spent decades refining what you feel at your fingertips when you pull a lever.

Checked by hand, one by one.<br/>한 줄씩, 손: Checked by hand, one by one.
니센은 케이블을 출고하기 전에 로트마다 인장 시험을 하고, 포장할 때는: Before shipping, Nissen tensile-tests every lot, and when packing, staff check each cable by eye and by touch for scratches or dirt. Cables with leftover oil, any kink at all, or frayed ends are all rejected. With inspection this strict, around 1 to 2% of every lot cannot be shipped.
이너 케이블 끝의 타이코(니플)는 일본 JIS 규격의 인장 강도 150k: The nipple (taiko) at the end of the inner cable is made to a tensile standard of at least 240 kgf, stricter than the 150 kgf of the Japanese JIS standard. However strong a cable is, it is dangerous if the end is poorly made.
철 대신 녹에 강한 스테인리스. 비와 땀에도 처음의 매끄러움을 오래 지킵: Rust-resistant stainless instead of steel. It keeps its original smoothness through rain and sweat.
보통의 이너 케이블은 19가닥. SP31은 굵기가 다른 31가닥을 촘촘히: A standard inner cable has 19 strands. SP31 tightly twists 31 strands of different thicknesses, so it is more flexible and stretches less.
모든 케이블을 작업자가 눈과 손으로 확인합니다. 합격한 것만 포장해 출고: Every cable is checked by eye and by hand. Only those that pass are packed and shipped.
투명한 컬러 코팅 아래로 스테인리스 코일이 비칩니다. 아우터 한 줄이 자: The stainless coil shows through a clear colour coating. One line of outer completes the look of the bike.
From inner cable to outer casing. The easiest way to transform your braking and shifting.
31가닥 스테인리스에 스릭 가공과 전착 코팅. 유연하고 늘어남이 적고 가: 31-strand stainless with slick finishing and electrodeposition coating. A flexible, low-stretch inner cable with a light pull.
스테인리스 코일과 투명 컬러 코팅, 폴리에틸렌 라이너. 브레이크용과 변속: Stainless coil, clear colour coating and polyethylene liner. 27 colours for brake and shift.
압축을 줄인 다이렉트, PTFE 라이너의 프리미엄, 11단 변속을 위한: Direct with less compression, Premium with a PTFE liner, and Ver.3 for 11-speed shifting.
1950~1970년대 유럽의 둥근 코일 아우터를 다시 만들었습니다. 라이: A reissue of 1950s to 1970s European round-wire casing. With a liner added, it performs like a modern cable.
무게가 절반인 알루미늄 아우터, 1960~70년대 캄파뇰로 스프링 아우터: An aluminium outer at half the weight, and a reissued set of 1960s to 70s Campagnolo spring outer.
31 strands, not 19,
smooth all the way to the lever.
보통의 이너 케이블은 19가닥의 소선을 꼬아 만듭니다. SP31은 31가: A standard inner cable is twisted from 19 strands. SP31 has 31. Using strands of different thicknesses inside makes it more flexible, and the tight twist leaves fewer gaps between strands. That makes it easier to install through tight routing around the bars, and with less stretch there is less re-adjustment after fitting. Breaking strength is also about 10% higher.
표면은 깎아서 진원에 가깝게 만드는 스릭(slick) 가공을 한 뒤, 특: The surface is shaved close to a perfect circle with a slick finish, then given a special electrodeposition coating. Friction is lower than with a slick finish alone or a PTFE (Teflon) coating, and the coating resists peeling, so the light pull lasts. It is also pre-stretched to reduce initial stretch.
31가닥 구조라 기존 케이블보다 부드럽게 휩니다. 라우팅이 까다로운 요즘: The 31-strand construction bends more smoothly than conventional cable. Installation is easier even with today's tight routing around the bars, and operation feels lighter.
촘촘하게 꼬여 늘어남이 적고 하중에 강합니다. 파단 강도 약 10% 향상: The tight twist means less stretch and greater load strength. About 10% higher breaking strength, and pre-stretching means less re-adjustment after fitting.
스릭 가공 뒤 전착 코팅. 스릭 가공만 하거나 PTFE 코팅을 한 케이블: Slick finish followed by electrodeposition coating. Lower friction than slick-only or PTFE-coated cables, with a coating that lasts.

SP31은 국내에서는 만들기 어려운 금형과 특수 도금이 필요해, 대만에: SP31 needs dies and special plating that are hard to produce in Japan, so Nissen made dedicated dies (with the N mark) in Taiwan and produces it there to its own specification. All Nissen products other than SP31 are made in Japan.
대만에서 출하할 때와 일본에 들어올 때 로트마다 인장 시험을 하고, 기준: Every lot is tensile-tested when it ships from Taiwan and again when it arrives in Japan, and any lot that falls short is returned or scrapped. Then staff inspect each cable by eye and by hand before packing. Genuine SP31 has an N mark on the nipple at the end of the cable.

A coil that won't rust,
the final line
that completes your bike.
보통 철로 만드는 아우터 케이블의 코일을 스테인리스로 바꿨습니다. 녹에: Nissen replaces the steel coil normally used in outer casing with stainless steel. It resists rust, and the metal coil shows through a clear colour coating. A polyethylene liner inside lightens the brake lever pull. One outer lets you enjoy dressing up and upgrading at the same time.
브레이크용은 바깥지름 5mm로 1.5mm 또는 1.6mm 이너를, 변속용: The brake outer has a 5 mm outer diameter for 1.5 or 1.6 mm inner cable; the shift outer is 4 mm for 1.2 mm inner. Sold in 2 m lengths, enough for one road bike, in 27 colours from Clear and Clear Black to traditional Japanese colours.
<b>다이렉트(브레이크용)</b>는 코일 소선을 굵게 하고 코일 사이의: Direct (brake) uses thicker coil wire with tighter gaps, greatly reducing compression under load. It keeps the flexibility while raising stiffness and giving a more direct braking feel. Recommended for mechanical disc brakes.
<b>프리미엄(브레이크용)</b>은 의료와 반도체 장비에도 쓰이는 PTF: Premium (brake) adds a PTFE liner, also used in medical and semiconductor equipment, for lower friction and better durability. Sold only as a brake set with SP31 inner cables. Shift Ver.3 uses a thicker coil to handle the fine adjustment of 11-speed shifting.

Making the cables of the 1950s
again, today.
1950년부터 1970년 무렵까지 유럽에서 만들던 철제 둥근 코일(환선): A reissue of the steel round-wire outer casing made in Europe from about 1950 to 1970. With a liner that the originals never had, the lever pulls lightly. Vintage in looks, modern in performance.
컬러는 몇 번이고 색을 맞춰 그 시절 아우터에 최대한 가깝게 만들었습니다: The colours were matched again and again to come as close as possible to the outers of the time: Black, White, Silver, Red, Blue, Yellow, French Blue, Celeste, British Green, Legnano Green, Sakura, Wakakusa and Indigo Blue, 13 in all. For brakes, sold in 2 m lengths.
1950년대 주로 이탈리아에서 쓰이던 유니버설(Universal)의 아우: A reissue of the outer casing made by Universal, used mainly in Italy in the 1950s. Its hallmark is the mesh pattern on the surface.
1950~1970년 무렵 프랑스의 르네 에르스(René Herse)와 알: A reissue of the outer casing used by René Herse and Alex Singer in France from about 1950 to 1970. Its hallmark is the wavy pattern where the round coil stands out on the surface.
The vintage outer with a stainless coil and a clear coating. The round-wire winding brings it closer to the originals. Clear, Clear Black, Classic Red, Laser Blue, Clear Purple.
코일을 알루미늄 합금으로 바꿔 1m에 약 27g. 2m 기준 일반 철제: An aluminium alloy coil brings the weight to about 27 g per metre. For 2 m, a standard steel outer's 115 g becomes 55 g. Developed with reference to the aluminium outer once made by France's CLB, with four aluminium caps included.
1960~1970년 무렵 캄파뇰로의 스프링 아우터를 감김 방향까지 그대로: A reissue of Campagnolo's spring outer from about 1960 to 1970, right down to the winding direction. Italian model 210 mm, Japan model 310 mm.
Choosing the right cable
for your bike.
케이블은 브레이크용과 변속용의 굵기와 구조가 다르고, 이너 굵기에 맞는: Brake and shift cables differ in diameter and construction, and the basic rule is to choose an outer that matches your inner. Nissen itself recommends consulting a mechanic who can see your actual bike about installation and compatibility. At Rubi Workshop we choose the right combination for your bike and install it for you.
앞 1m · 뒤 2m · 롱 2.5m: Front 1 m · rear 2 m · long 2.5 m
유압 브레이크와 전동 변속에는 쓰이지 않으며, 레버와 브레이크, 변속기의: Not for hydraulic brakes or electronic shifting, and the right cable can vary with your levers, brakes and derailleurs. The stainless shift outer has a coil construction, so Ver.3 is recommended for 10 to 11-speed shifting. If your levers start to feel heavy or your shifting drifts, it is time to check your cables.
자전거와 레버, 브레이크와 변속기 종류를 확인하고 맞는 케이블을 고릅니다: We check your bike, levers, brakes and derailleurs, and choose the right cables.
See the housing colours in person and match them to your frame, bar tape and grips.
핸들을 끝까지 돌려도 당기지 않는 길이로, 아우터 끝을 반듯하게 잘라 마: Lengths that never pull even at full steering lock, with housing ends cut square and finished cleanly.
브레이크 간격과 변속을 다시 맞추고, 초기 늘어남 뒤에도 점검해 드립니다: We re-adjust brake clearance and shifting, and check again after the initial stretch.
From loom springs
to bicycle cables:
the Nissen story.
1948년 오사카 기시와다에서 직기의 스프링을 만들던 작은 공장은, 자전: In 1948 a small factory in Kishiwada, Osaka was making springs for weaving looms. When it began making bicycle brake wire, it became Nissen Cable in 1973. For years it made cables behind the names of bicycle and brake makers; today it presents SP31, its colour outers and its vintage outers under the Nissen name.
Founded as Sadoya Spring (佐土谷発條), making springs for weaving looms.
자전거 브레이크 와이어로 영역을 넓히고, 회사 이름을 니센 케이블(日泉ケ: Moving into bicycle brake wire, the company changes its name to Nissen Cable (日泉ケーブル).
자전거 회사와 브레이크 회사, 도매상의 케이블을 OEM으로 만들며 기술과: Making OEM cables for bicycle makers, brake makers and wholesalers, building up skill and experience.
31가닥 구조와 전착 코팅의 SP31 스페셜 스테인리스 이너를 선보입니다: Introduces the SP31 Special Stainless inner, with 31 strands and electrodeposition coating.
후지색, 쿠루미, 히스이, 맛차, 아즈키, 가키색, 후카미도리. 일본 전: Fuji, Kurumi, Hisui, Matcha, Azuki, Kaki and Fukamidori. Introduces stainless outers in traditional Japanese colours.
오사카·간사이 엑스포에 참가하고, 스테인리스 아우터의 새 컬러 샴페인 골: Exhibits at Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai, and introduces a new stainless outer colour, Champagne Gold.
